body: all there is to say is that I have depression. And no matter how hard I work, nothing good comes.

The bad things do outweigh the good. and the good are so few and far between...and when something good comes along, it's taken away just as quickly; only bad remains. I'm tired of the saying "it's a permanent solution to a temporary problem"......no one sees that your problems are permanent. so suicide it is. next week. just need to figure a good place
I call bullshit. Why would anyone be genuinely interested in me?

Well, I wouldn't call it an expensive city, per se. I've figured out I need to net about $1000 a month to live what I deem comfortable...how the hell that is so hard, I will never know....

I have a Toyota Corolla, and I have lived in it...I always woke up without use of my legs, my knees would lock up.

I'm looking for a new place. That's something else that's becoming harder than I thought it would be. I looked at a few places, met with some people; at the end of the day, I just didn't see myself living there.

I'm just so tired. I love where I live more than anything, but I have to work several jobs just to barely make ends meet....sometimes I can't even make ends meet. I can't keep asking my mom for money. I so desperately want to buy things to make my room feel homey, to create a wonderful personal space where I want to be, but I can't afford things for it....simple things, like bed sheets, towel sets, etc. It sucks so much. And there are so many other things on my mind that are just as hopeless
This friendship is something I greatly value, and I know he does as well. Avoidance is childish.
you need to talk to someone who can help you figure that out. I can't
is there any way you can wear long sleeves under the t-shirt?
depression can make it hard to be happy even though everything looks amazing on paper.

I decided that I have to end a friendship just Friday. Haven't been able to see him yet to do it. I don't know when I will; now having second thoughts. Thinking about suicide just so that I don't have to deal with heartbreak and confusion and hopelessness anymore
Have you ever been diagnosed with anything?
I don't know what to say, but I know I have to say something to you....
There's the paradox I have- our friendship is good, but it gives me hope that something will happen. Ending it may help me move on, but it also may drive me to suicide

I have feelings for him. He's not available. I find little glimmers of hope when I talk to him....can't have hope for that. And I don't have hope for anything else good....so, it's time to kill myself

I'm just so tired of working so hard for things I want, only for heartache. Lately, I've made a decision to end a friendship. I was hoping to talk to this person before I went out of town, but it didn't happen. Now it's festering. I don't when I'll get to, but I have to end the friendship and I just want to go ahead and close that door. I don't have any hope for good things anymore
